Subject: Private CP: SSO + SCIM provisioning for BigClient.io (hybrid on-prem)

Hi team —

Following our intro call with BigClient.io, they want Redwood Private (VPC + on-prem connector) to rely on their IdP for employee auth and user provisioning. High-level asks:

- SAML 2.0 for authentication to the Private Control Plane (browser SSO for admin UX)
- SCIM 2.0 for provisioning groups/users into Private CP; BigClient will provision from Okta
- Support for service accounts / machine-to-machine roles (for their infra team)

Can CloudCorp IdP team confirm the metadata exchange format and any attribute mapping constraints? Dev – can you outline firewall / egress requirements for the on-prem connector and whether we need a callback URL for SCIM? Marcus – any policy/role mapping notes for the Control Plane IAM?

I attached an initial attribute mapping sheet and the control plane requirements doc. Goal: test tenant by next Wed (2027-06-02).

Thanks,
Sofia

Hi Sofia / Redwood team —

Thanks for the summary. Quick answers up front:

1) SAML metadata: we can provide both entityID and signing cert in a single XML (attached: saml-metadata-cloudcorp.xml). We recommend SHA256 signing; support for RSA-PSS is limited on older SPs.

2) SCIM: CloudCorp exposes SCIM 2.0 with PATCH support and pagination. The base URL will be /scim/v2/Users and /scim/v2/Groups. Rate limits default to 60 req/min but can be raised for onboarding. The SCIM payload includes externalId, userName, active, name, emails, and groups. Group membership is via Group resources (members array).

3) Attribute mapping: Okta can send custom attributes. We suggest mapping:
   - email -> userName / emails[0].value
   - displayName -> name.formatted
   - department -> entitlements or custom extension claim for role mapping in the CP

4) Service accounts: for machine auth we recommend issuing scoped OAuth2 client credentials the CP will accept, and we can emit a serviceAccount flag in SCIM as extension. If the CP needs JWT-based trust, we can exchange certs during onboarding.

We can spin up a dedicated test tenant (tenant-id: cloudcorp-test-BCI) for BigClient with elevated SCIM throughput for 72h.

Questions for you:
- Does the Private CP run behind an egress-restricted on-prem connector (i.e., no inbound)? If so, SCIM calls must be outbound from your connector to our SCIM endpoint or routed through a proxy.
- Do you require just-in-time (JIT) provisioning on first SSO, or full SCIM sync?

Happy to schedule a 60-min technical walkthrough.

- Alex (IdP Engineering Lead)
CloudCorp Identity
From: sofia_ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Private CP: SSO + SCIM provisioning for BigClient.io (hybrid on-prem)

Alex — thanks, this is helpful. Answers inline:

- On premise connector: BigClient will deploy our connector in a DMZ with only outbound egress allowed. No inbound connections to the connector are permitted.
- They want a full initial SCIM sync (backfill) followed by incremental provisioning. JIT is acceptable as fallback for edge cases.
- Service accounts: they specifically asked for mapping Okta-managed service accounts into CP with the ability to bind them to IAM roles. Marcus, can we accept a serviceAccount extension on SCIM and map it to a "machine" principal with limited privileges?

Next steps:
1) Dev: please post required outbound endpoints / ports so BigClient's infra can pre-approve firewall rules.
2) Alex: if you can provision the test tenant and increase SCIM rate limits, we'll schedule the walkthrough and confirm the backfill window.

Sofia

Quick tech notes for firewall / connector egress and SCIM tests:

Outbound endpoints (HTTPS):
- idp SCIM: https://scim.cloudcorp.com (443)
- idp SAML metadata endpoint: https://sso.cloudcorp.com/.well-known/saml (443)
- control plane telemetry / health: https://cp-ingest.redwood.ai (443) -- for status checks only

Connector requirements:
- Outbound only, TLS 1.2+ (TLS 1.3 preferred).
- Mutual TLS (mTLS) optional for SCIM; we support bearer token authorization with rotating API keys.
- Allowlist our public CA certs for OCSP/CRL checks if their network blocks external CAs.

SCIM considerations:
- Backfill approach: incremental windowed sync (we recommend paging size 100, with deltaToken support). We'll orchestrate backfill from the CP side by requesting all users and reconciling.
- Conflict resolution: authoritative source = IdP (Okta); if email changes, update CP profile; if user is deactivated in SCIM, CP will soft-delete and follow retention policy.

Test plan for the walkthrough:
1) Exchange SAML metadata + verify SP/IdP SSO (browser admin login)
2) Run a manual SCIM create for 5 test users (okta-user1..5)
3) Full backfill simulation (staging tenant)
4) Provision one service account and bind to read-only role; validate token exchange

I'll attach a minimal test script and the expected SCIM payload example in the runbook (attached).

- Dev

We confirmed test tenant (cloudcorp-test-BCI) and raised SCIM rate to 300 req/min for the 72h window starting 2027-06-01T00:00:00Z. Attached is the saml-metadata-cloudcorp.xml and a short SCIM spec doc.

We support an extension attribute "urn:cloudcorp:extension:serviceAccount" which we can set to true for Okta-managed service accounts. For machine principals, we can emit a claim "x-roles" that lists role names; you can map those to CP IAM roles during onboarding.

We will hold a technical walkthrough on 2027-06-01 at 10:00 PT. Please confirm attendees and we'll send a calendar invite with a temporary test SSO link.

- Alex
